cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：历史的
cards.example_en: The museum showed historical photos of our town.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了我们小镇的历史照片。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：个人的
cards.example_en: Each pupil has a personal locker in the changing room.
cards.example_zh: 每个学生在更衣室都有一个个人储物柜。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：实用的
cards.example_en: These practical shoes are good for walking to school.
cards.example_zh: 这双实用的鞋很适合走路去上学。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：完全；总共
cards.example_en: The bill was twenty yuan altogether.

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Weather is a factor in the plan.
cards.example_zh: 天气是计划中的一个因素。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: The play ends with a murder, so younger pupils should not watch.
cards.example_zh: 这出戏以一场谋杀结束，低年级学生不适合看。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: I used a rubber to erase the wrong maths sum.
cards.example_zh: 我用橡皮把算错的那道数学题擦掉了。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：高年级的
cards.example_en: The senior students organised the sports day stalls.
cards.example_zh: 高年级学生组织了运动会的摊位。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: Our maths teacher stayed late to mark our graphs.
cards.example_zh: 我们的数学老师留到很晚，批改我们的图表。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：由……组成
cards.example_en: The dinner will consist of rice, soup, and fish.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭将由米饭、汤和鱼组成。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: The villagers will resist the plan to close their clinic.
cards.example_zh: 村民们将抵制关闭他们诊所的计划。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：严重地；很差
cards.example_en: She cut her finger badly while cooking.
cards.example_zh: 她做饭时手指伤得很重。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：基本上

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.example_en: The baby patted his round belly after drinking milk.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝喝完奶，拍了拍自己圆圆的肚子。

cards.scene: 校园学习 · School and Education
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：完全地
cards.example_en: I fully understand this grammar rule now.
cards.example_zh: 我现在完全明白这条语法规则了。
